annotation.title_clean: 医薬品、医療機器等の品質、有効性及び安全性の確保等に関する法律施行規則
annotation.title_en: Ordinance for Enforcement of the Act on Securing Quality, Efficacy and Safety of Products Including Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare (Japan)
annotation.summary_en: Japan's Ministerial Ordinance implementing the Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Act, specifying procedures, forms and standards for pharmacies, manufacturers/marketing authorisation holders of drugs, medical devices and regenerative products, registered certification bodies, safety measures, recalls and supervision. It contains no AI or robotics-specific provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Sets licensing and application procedures for pharmacies and marketing/manufacturing businesses
Defines standards for regional-cooperation and specialised pharmacies
Establishes registered certification body requirements for medical devices
Requires adverse-reaction reporting and recall reporting to the Minister
Includes supervision, designated substances and orphan product designation rules
